announcements.headline: Improved economics published in the updated PFS
announcements.insight: Phoenix Copper Limited published an updated PFS following its November auditor change. This suggests progress in project development and potential future capital requirements.

announcements.insight: Phoenix Copper Limited has changed its auditor. This follows the completion of a fundraise in July 2026 and interim results in September 2026.

announcements.insight: The fundraise follows the July retail offer. Shareholders should monitor capital deployment.

announcements.headline: Proposed Placing, Subscription and Retail Offer
announcements.insight: Phoenix Copper Limited is initiating a capital raise through a placing, subscription, and retail offer. This represents a significant funding event for the company.
